description: Machine-readable inventory of security audit checks for validation and generated maps.

statusTaxonomy.present: The expected invariant is fully satisfied.
statusTaxonomy.partial: Most signals resolve, with a small number of exceptions, or the check is heuristic and the codebase shows mixed adherence.
statusTaxonomy.violation: Concrete code or configuration breaks the invariant.

enrichmentFlags.description: Run installed security-focused linters and Semgrep when available, then use their JSON output to enrich relevant findings.

relatedAudits.relationship: Owns dependency vulnerabilities and supply-chain analysis.
Owns error redaction and logging hygiene; secret logging gaps overlap.

checks.title: Session tokens not in localStorage
checks.expectation: Long-lived session and authentication tokens live in HttpOnly cookies, not localStorage or sessionStorage.
checks.violationSignal: localStorage or sessionStorage calls use keys matching authentication-token patterns.

checks.title: Logout invalidates server session
checks.expectation: Logout calls a server endpoint and awaits or handles the result, instead of only clearing local state.
checks.violationSignal: A logout flow only clears local store or state with no server request.

checks.title: Authentication state is server-derived
checks.expectation: The logged-in check resolves against a server source of truth on navigation or load.
checks.violationSignal: Authentication state is read only from client storage without server validation.

checks.title: OAuth and OIDC flows use PKCE
checks.expectation: Public-client OAuth flows generate a code verifier and send a code challenge in the authorization request.
checks.violationSignal: An OAuth flow for a public client does not use PKCE.

checks.title: OAuth flows use a state parameter
checks.expectation: Every OAuth authorization request includes a CSRF-resistant state value that is validated on callback.
checks.violationSignal: The state value is absent from the authorization request or absent from callback validation.

checks.title: OIDC flows use a nonce
checks.expectation: OpenID Connect flows include a nonce in the authorization request and validate it on the ID token.
checks.violationSignal: The nonce is absent or unvalidated.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: No OpenID Connect flow is detected.

checks.title: Redirect URIs are explicitly handled
checks.expectation: Post-authentication redirect destinations are validated against an allowlist or restricted to relative paths.
checks.violationSignal: A next or returnTo query parameter is passed directly to router.push or window.location without validation.

checks.title: Server-side authorization referenced
checks.expectation: UI-only authorization checks are paired with server-enforced checks at the data-fetching layer.
checks.violationSignal: Permission checks appear only in components and route guards, with no role or permission references in the data-fetching layer.

checks.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML only with sanitization
checks.expectation: Every dangerouslySetInnerHTML use consumes trusted server-rendered content or sanitized input from DOMPurify or an equivalent library.
checks.violationSignal: dangerouslySetInnerHTML payload is reachable from user input, untrusted props, or fetched data without sanitization.

checks.title: No eval or dynamic code execution
checks.expectation: Source code does not use eval, new Function, Function(...), or string-form setTimeout or setInterval.
checks.violationSignal: Any dynamic code execution primitive appears in source.

checks.title: No raw innerHTML or outerHTML writes
checks.expectation: DOM mutations go through React instead of direct innerHTML or outerHTML writes.
checks.violationSignal: Direct innerHTML or outerHTML writes use a non-literal right-hand side.

checks.title: URL href and src validated
checks.expectation: User-controlled URLs in href, src, or formAction allow only http, https, or relative paths.
checks.violationSignal: A user-controlled href, src, or formAction expression has no protocol check and may allow javascript or data schemes.

checks.title: Open-redirect patterns guarded
checks.expectation: Redirect destinations are not user-controlled unless validated by an allowlist or constrained to safe relative paths.
checks.violationSignal: A redirect call site uses a destination from query parameters or form input without an allowlist.

checks.title: Markdown and rich-text rendering use a safe pipeline
checks.expectation: Markdown or rich text is rendered with HTML disabled by default or sanitized after rendering.
checks.violationSignal: Markdown is rendered with HTML pass-through enabled and no sanitization.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: No Markdown or rich-text rendering is detected.

checks.title: No bypassing React escaping
checks.expectation: React escaping remains active; raw HTML strings, custom JSX runtimes that disable escaping, and unsafe rendering components are absent.
checks.violationSignal: React.createElement with raw HTML strings, unsafe custom JSX runtimes, or third-party unsafe render components are detected.

checks.title: HTTPS enforced
checks.expectation: The deployed application redirects HTTP to HTTPS at the platform or edge layer, or sends a meaningful Strict-Transport-Security header.
checks.violationSignal: No HTTPS redirect configuration or meaningful Strict-Transport-Security response header is detected.

checks.title: Strict-Transport-Security set
checks.expectation: The Strict-Transport-Security header has max-age of at least 15768000 seconds; includeSubDomains and preload are recommended for production.
checks.violationSignal: The header is missing or max-age is shorter than the threshold.

checks.title: Content Security Policy defined
checks.expectation: A Content Security Policy is set by response header or meta tag.
checks.violationSignal: No Content Security Policy is detected anywhere.

checks.title: Content Security Policy not overly permissive
checks.expectation: The Content Security Policy avoids unsafe-eval, wildcard script sources, and unsafe-inline unless a nonce or hash strategy is documented.
checks.violationSignal: The policy uses unsafe-eval, script-src *, or unsafe-inline without documented mitigation.

checks.title: Frame ancestors restricted
checks.expectation: Content Security Policy frame-ancestors is set, or X-Frame-Options is DENY or SAMEORIGIN.
checks.violationSignal: Neither frame-ancestors nor X-Frame-Options is detected.

checks.title: X-Content-Type-Options nosniff set
checks.expectation: The X-Content-Type-Options header is configured with nosniff.
checks.violationSignal: The X-Content-Type-Options header is missing.

checks.title: Referrer-Policy set
checks.expectation: A non-default Referrer-Policy is configured, such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter.
checks.violationSignal: The header is missing or set to unsafe-url.

checks.title: Permissions-Policy set
checks.expectation: A Permissions-Policy header restricts dangerous browser features to origins that need them.
checks.violationSignal: The Permissions-Policy header is missing.

checks.title: Cookies use Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite
checks.expectation: Authentication and session cookies carry Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax or stricter flags.
checks.violationSignal: Cookies are set without Secure, HttpOnly, or SameSite flags.

checks.title: No mixed content
checks.expectation: Production asset URLs and fetch URLs use https or relative paths.
checks.violationSignal: An http URL literal appears in production source.

checks.title: No secrets in source
checks.expectation: Source files contain no API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys, or signing secrets as string literals.
checks.violationSignal: Secret-detection patterns match source files.

checks.title: .env files git-ignored
checks.expectation: .gitignore excludes .env, .env.local, and .env.*.local files.
checks.violationSignal: An .env file is tracked, or the required ignore pattern is absent.

checks.title: Public-prefix environment variables are actually public
checks.expectation: Environment variables that are inlined into the client bundle do not carry secret-looking names or values.
checks.violationSignal: A public-prefix variable name suggests secret, private, token, or non-public key material.

checks.title: No PII in URL paths or query strings
checks.expectation: Routing and link generation avoid email addresses, phone numbers, government identifiers, and API tokens in URLs.
checks.violationSignal: Route or link parameter names match PII patterns such as email, phone, ssn, creditCard, or taxId.

checks.title: No PII in client-side analytics
checks.expectation: Analytics event payloads do not include obvious PII fields.
checks.violationSignal: Event property names matching PII patterns are passed to analytics providers.

checks.title: Subresource Integrity on external scripts
checks.expectation: Script tags from non-first-party origins carry an integrity attribute.
checks.violationSignal: External scripts lack Subresource Integrity hashes.

checks.title: Third-party iframes are sandboxed
checks.expectation: Iframes pointing at non-first-party origins use the sandbox attribute with the most restrictive permissions that still work.
checks.violationSignal: Third-party iframes lack a sandbox attribute.

checks.title: postMessage origin validation
checks.expectation: message event handlers check event.origin against an allowlist before acting on event.data.
checks.violationSignal: A message listener reads event.data without checking event.origin.

checks.title: target blank paired with rel noopener noreferrer
checks.expectation: External links opening new tabs include rel="noopener noreferrer".
checks.violationSignal: An anchor has target="_blank" without rel="noopener noreferrer".

checks.title: No console-logged secrets
checks.expectation: Code does not pass authentication tokens, environment-variable values, or full request-header objects to console calls or third-party loggers.
checks.violationSignal: Logging patterns include authentication tokens, environment-variable values, or full request headers.

checks.title: Weak cryptographic primitives flagged
checks.expectation: MD5 and SHA-1 are not used for security-relevant hashing, signing, or fingerprinting.
checks.violationSignal: crypto.createHash calls with md5 or sha1 appear in security-looking code paths.
